name: AI Image generation module
description: Admin form that generates images from text prompts via the OpenAI DALL·E API and saves them as Media entities.
project_description:
The Image Genie AI module utilizes OpenAI's DALL·E models to convert textual descriptions into images. This technology is groundbreaking because it bridges the gap between language and visual creativity. It allows users to create images from textual descriptions, offering a choice between different versions of the model, like DALL·E 2 and DALL·E 3.Each version has its own set of features and enhancements

 DALL·E 2 vs. DALL·E 3 

 DALL·E 2 and DALL·E 3 are different iterations of the model, each with its own advancements. DALL·E 2 focused on creating images that combine various concepts in novel ways.

 DALL·E 3 takes this further by improving the nuances and details, translating ideas into exceptionally accurate images. With DALL·E 3, users have the added flexibility to specify parameters that affect the image quality and can choose from various standards or styles,

 such as vivid or natural.This level of controls enables user to influence the output's fidelity and artistic interpretation to suit their needs.

 Additional Requirements: 

Users must register on the OpenAI platform to get an API secret key and add it in API configuration form. This key is crucial for authenticating and securely accessing the DALL·E service's and other OpenAI services. To get your API key click here OpenAI website.
